name: ANSI/IEEE on-delay timer relay symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for on-delay timer relay, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The on-delay timer operating form identifies a timing element whose specified output transition is postponed after initiation. Trigger, auxiliary supply and delayed output are distinct circuit information, even when the timer assembly combines them.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Read the start and reset conditions from the timer timing chart.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: An on-delay operating element differs from a delayed contact drawn separately under the same timer tag.
